var_def: Stable GeoDevelopment Observatory identifier for the fixed 2025 map343 municipality or Indigenous autonomy.
label: Map343 ID

var_def: Name as published in the pinned map343 source.
label: Municipal unit

var_def: Calendar year of the gridded estimate on retrospective fixed 2025 boundaries.
label: Year

var_def: Estimated GDP allocated from the PWT 11.0-anchored source grid using fixed within-cell municipal overlap shares. Does not include unmatched source cells.
label: GDP (million 2021 PPP US$)

var_def: INE annual projection in persons on the fixed map343 geography. Linked historical groups use census-share interpolation.
label: Harmonized INE projected population (persons)

var_def: Area-allocated GDP divided by annual harmonized INE population. Not observed municipal accounts.
label: Estimated GDP per capita (2021 PPP US$)

var_def: Natural logarithm of estimated GDP per capita when positive.
label: Log GDP per capita

var_def: Denominator provenance: ine_yearbook_projection for a one-to-one historical roster match or census_share_interpolated for a split within a linked historical group.
label: INE denominator method

var_def: Historical map339 ID or a plus-separated group of IDs whose annual INE projection is conserved.
label: Historical projection group

var_def: 2012 INE census resident count tabulated on fixed map343 boundaries. Only populated for year 2012.
label: 2012 census population (persons)

var_def: Estimated GDP in 2012 divided by census residents rather than the annual projection. Only populated for year 2012; not part of the annual GDP per capita series.
label: GDP per 2012 census resident (2021 PPP US$)

var_def: Estimated population allocated from the PWT 11.0-anchored source grid using the same fixed overlap shares as GDP. Does not include unmatched source cells.
label: Population (millions)

var_def: Previous diagnostic ratio of area-allocated GDP to area-allocated PWT grid population; not the default GDP per capita.
label: GDP per modeled PWT resident (2021 PPP US$)

var_def: Natural logarithm of GDP per modeled PWT resident when positive.
label: Log GDP per modeled PWT resident

var_def: Share of municipal polygon area covered by contributing source grid cells before allocation.
label: Municipal area covered by source grid

var_def: Geometric source-grid support classified independently of GDP censoring.
label: Source-grid coverage status

var_def: Number of source grid cells with positive overlap included in the estimate.
label: Contributing cells

var_def: Number of contributing cells whose GDP is censored by the source in this year.
label: Contributing GDP-censored cells

var_def: Fraction of covered municipal area coming from GDP-censored source cells in this year.
label: Covered area from GDP-censored cells

var_def: Fraction of allocated municipal population originating in GDP-censored source cells when municipal population is positive.
label: Allocated population from GDP-censored cells

var_def: Source GDP censoring status among contributing cells. Censoring of GDP does not imply zero population.
label: Source GDP censoring status
